description: The verifier's record: commands run, test counts, which acceptance criteria fail, and the mechanical checks.

summary.description: One short line the runner printed, such as `13 passed` or `2 failed, 11 passed`: at most 80 characters, and only letters, digits, spaces and `, . : ; ( ) % / _ + -`. The characters of source code (quotes, brackets, `=`) are refused, so that no test's source or assertion travels in this record.

failing_acs.description: The acceptance criteria whose tests fail. Each carries the kind of error only, never the assertion text: the builder reads this record and must not learn what the tests assert.

error_type.description: The kind of failure as one short token, such as AssertionError, TypeError or Timeout. Never an assertion message: whitespace is rejected, which keeps assertion text out.

checks.description: Mechanical checks. Each is true (passed), false (failed) or null (not applicable).

green.description: True when every command and every applicable check passed.

diff_sha256.description: The sha256 of the change this record covers: the diff from the run's merge base to the files as they were, untracked files included, as `plumbline.py check-diff` prints it. `pass` refuses when the diff of HEAD hashes differently, so a change edited after this record was made fails.
